title: Minimal 3D scene exported for Android/ARMv7 consistently crashes in comptibility rendering mode
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1.stable on Linux Ubuntu 24.04

### System information

Xiaomi Redmi 9A (MediaTek MT6762G, Android 11, API 30, OpenGL ES 3.2)

### Issue description

A minimal 3D scene simply consisting of a root Node3D, a Camera3D and a DirectionalLight3D (added via "Add Sun to Scene" to have shadows ON) consistently crashes after 161281 frames (~45min at 60fps) when executed on a Xiaomi Redmi 9A. 

Turning off the shadows in the DirectionalLight3D node prevents the crash to happen.

The same app does not crash when tested on a Leagoo M12 (also OpenGL ES 3.2).

### Steps to reproduce

In a new project with Compatibility Rendering Mode, create a new scene with Node3D as root
Add a Camera3D
Go to "Edit Sun and Environment settings" and click "Add Sun to Scene"
Go to Project->Export and select Android(Runnable) as preset
In Architectures check "armeabi-v7a" and uncheck "arm64-v8a"
Export, execute on a Xiaomi Redmi 9A, wait 45min
